sentence: This project builds mathematical theory and software that finds mobile genetic elements in microbial genomes faster and more accurately.
This project uses Magnetic Resonance Fingerprinting and machine learning to build a fast imaging method for high-resolution pictures of the brain.
This project builds a system that uses electron microscopy on frozen samples to capture how large molecular complexes change their structure over time.
This project studies how a structure built around a modified protein switches on a protein complex that controls cell growth and proliferation.
This project tries to find out what causes diseases that harm the skeleton, such as osteoporosis and osteoarthritis, by studying molecular changes.
This project tests whether a genetic score for the activity of an enzyme that breaks down nicotine is linked to lung cancer risk in smokers.
This project uses a mouse model to study how stress and viral infection during pregnancy affect the immune system and behavior of offspring.
This project builds a fast way to 3D-print dental zirconia crowns in the dental chair by speeding up debinding and sintering.
This project builds an imaging tool that detects bone infection, called osteomyelitis, in people with sickle cell disease.
This project studies how the mitotic spindle forms and how it adjusts its size and shape in different cell types of Xenopus.
This project compares neural crest stem cells and blastula stem cells in three model systems to find the gene regulatory networks behind them.
This project tries to find antibodies that mark brain diseases caused by the immune system, called autoimmune encephalopathies.
This project tests a biodegradable gel and focused ultrasound as a way to deliver neural stem cells that attack glioblastoma multiforme tumor cells.
This project covers metabolomics, a set of methods that measure changes in metabolites in cells, including tumor cells.
This project studies how the epithelium and nearby immune cells drive lasting inflammation when a respiratory viral infection strikes people with asthma.
This project uses a mouse migraine model to study how stress changes the gut microbiome and whether that helps cause migraine.
This project builds chemical tools to find which proteins covalent drugs bind and how much of each protein the drugs occupy.
This project builds a chip with human vascular tissue and fast imaging to study blood clots and possible drugs.
This project studies how a cell signaling process controls mitochondria and immune behavior in macrophages found in tumors.
